learning_outcomes.text: Apply acquired knowledge to identify, formulate and solve problems in broad contexts, being able to integrate them by working in multidisciplinary teams
Understand the impact of engineering on the environment, the sustainable development of society and the importance of working in a professional and responsible environment.
Communicate knowledge and conclusions, both orally and in writing, to specialized and non-specialized audiences clearly and unambiguously.
Possess learning skills that allow continuous study throughout life for adequate professional development
Incorporate ICT and Industrial Engineering technologies and tools into professional activities.
Know and apply knowledge of basic sciences and technologies to the practice of Industrial Engineering
Knowledge and ability for the calculation and design of industrial structures and constructions.
Knowledge of applicable regulations for reinforced concrete structures.
Ability to interpret and generate construction plans.
Ability to design, manage works and build.
Ability to control projects and execution.
The student analyzes and applies regulations.
Achieve solid theoretical bases (materials, calculation and dimensioning methods...).
Ability to conceive, design and calculate the different elements of a structure built with reinforced concrete.
Design thinking about how it is to be built (construction process).
Knowledge of quality control processes (project, materials and execution).
Ability to create construction sketches and interpret execution plans.

syllabus_topics: U.L.S. OF FAILURE BY NORMAL STRESSES
Calculation of sections under normal stresses
U.L.S. OF FAILURE BY TANGENTIAL STRESSES
Dimensioning and reinforcement of beams. Graphic representation

assessment_methods.method: Application to practical cases and bending examples exercise

assessment_rules: All evaluable activities are graded out of 10. To pass the course, a minimum grade of 5.0 is required. For the Ordinary Call, the total grade for the course will be the maximum of (the weighted progressive score) or (the global exam score). A minimum of 4.0 in the theory part of the global exam is required; otherwise, the final grade will not exceed 4.5. For the Extraordinary Call, the exam accounts for 100% of the grade. A minimum of 5.0 is required to pass, and a minimum of 4.0 in the theory part is also required; otherwise, the final grade will not exceed 4.5.
